bio: Gidleigh Park is a stunning country house nestled in a wooded valley within the natural beauty of the wilds of Dartmoor in Devon.  Guests can enjoy a stroll in the stunning hotel grounds with the river Teign running through. The gardens have been planted to provide an array of colour against the hues of green that form the natural backdrop.  Afternoon Tea is served in the stunning Conservatory, lounges or terrace, where you can enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea including freshly cut finger sandwiches, freshly baked fruit and plain scones served with clotted cream and preserves, and an assortment of homemade cakes. Afternoon Tea is served with a selection of teas and why not include a glass of Champagne for an extra taste of indulgence.
